translation.messaging.trust.phishLookalikeCold: This message from a new or unaccepted contact includes a lookalike brand link. Do not enter passwords or recovery phrases from chat links.
translation.messaging.trust.seCold: This message from a new or unaccepted contact matches social-engineering patterns. Verify identity out of band before following instructions.
translation.messaging.trust.seCredentialCold: This contact asks for passwords, codes, or recovery phrases. Never share credentials in chat.
translation.messaging.trust.seRemoteAccessCold: This contact pushes remote-access or screen-share tools. Treat that as a high-risk scam signal.
translation.messaging.trust.seHiringTrapCold: This contact frames a job or hiring lure that asks for money or sensitive steps. Verify employers out of band.
translation.messaging.trust.seGiftCardCold: This contact asks you to buy gift cards or prepaid codes. That is a common scam — stop and verify out of band.
translation.messaging.trust.seOverpaymentCold: This contact describes an overpayment and asks for a refund. Treat refund-forward requests as a scam signal.
translation.messaging.trust.seFakeEscrowCold: This contact pushes a fake escrow or middleman payment story. Verify any escrow service independently.
translation.messaging.trust.seOffPlatformCold: This contact tries to move you off Obscur to another app or channel. Prefer staying here until you verify identity out of band.
translation.messaging.trust.seAdvanceFeeCold: This contact asks for an upfront fee to unlock money or a prize. Do not send advance payments from chat pressure.
translation.messaging.trust.seIrreversiblePaymentCol: This contact demands irreversible payment (crypto/wire) under pressure. Pause and verify out of band first.
translation.messaging.trust.seAuthorityCold: This contact impersonates authority (support, police, platform staff). Official help never asks for secrets in chat.

translation.settings.security.zeroKnowledge.title: Política de Conocimiento Cero
translation.settings.security.zeroKnowledge.desc: Obscur nunca comparte tus claves privadas ni mensajes sin cifrar. Las configuraciones de seguridad se almacenan localmente y nunca se sincronizan con ningún servidor remoto.
translation.settings.security.decentralizedReality.l: No hay «borrado en todas partes» a nivel de protocolo ni destrucción garantida de evidencia. El cifrado de extremo a extremo y los relés implican que pueden existir copias fuera de esta app. Es una propiedad de la arquitectura.
translation.settings.security.decentralizedReality.r: Obscur ofrece una alternativa práctica: redacción iniciada por el remitente (comando firmado) para que clientes que cooperan dejen de mostrar el mensaje y apliquen tumba local. Es el análogo honesto de «deshacer envío» sin servidor central.
Protecciones opcionales (p. ej. conciencia de phishing) pueden llegar en versiones posteriores; complementan esta base técnica.
translation.settings.security.trustV195.title: Trust notices in direct messages (v1.9.5)
translation.settings.security.trustV195.capabilities: Obscur evaluates incoming DM text on your device for cold-contact and financial or urgency patterns. When risk is elevated, a banner appears in the thread. Messages still arrive; senders are never notified.
translation.settings.security.trustV195.limits: Notices do not block delivery, report senders to Obscur, or replace accept, mute, or block. Those controls below remain your authoritative trust actions.
